title: Understone
description: Dig, build, craft, and fight in a vast procedurally generated 2D world. Mine ores by torchlight, forge better gear, raise a fortress, and face the monsters that own the night — including bosses that will end you if you come unprepared. A full sandbox survival adventure in the spirit of the genre classics.
short_description: Dig, build, craft, fight. A full 2D sandbox survival adventure.
controls_keyboard: A/D move, Space jump, mouse aim + left-click use, right-click interact, I inventory, C crafting, 1-0 hotbar, Esc pause. Drag items to move/equip.
controls_gamepad: Left stick move, A jump, right stick aim, RT use, Y inventory.
